fix(codeon): schedule rejected input recovery (#246)

* fix(config): accept runtime executable symlinks

* fix(postgres): cancel undispatched attempts

Durable cancellation can close selected, preparing, or prepared Attempts before an Agent runtime exists. Align the database terminal-state constraint with that domain authority when a runtime closure receipt proves the never-dispatched outcome.

* fix(runtime): restore Cursor and Grok startup

Accept current provider ACP contracts without fabricating account identity, and keep daemon startup probes separate from repository ambient inspection.

* fix(runtime): harden provider startup probes

Keep Cursor ambient validation mandatory through an isolated startup worktree, and reject ambiguous Grok authentication catalogs.

* fix(merge): reconcile external PR merges

Preserve strict metadata validation for Codeon mutations while allowing exact reviewed PRs merged externally to finalize through provider and Git readback.

* fix(runtime): recover dispatches after restart

* fix(runtime): recover transient agent failures

Normalize provider digest representations and keep operation-scoped errors from permanently disabling runtime profiles. Skip v2 activity writes for legacy Cursor operations.

* fix(codeon): classify legacy activity leases and bind dispatch evidence

Codex activity callbacks were mapped to PersistenceUnavailable whenever a
v1 dispatch had NULL lease columns, flooding logs and hiding SQLSTATE.
Classify that as PolicyUnavailable/IgnoredLegacyPolicy, keep real sqlx
details, and land the already-verified capacity owner accounting plus
same-Operation cross-dispatch coverage and current-dispatch publication
observation filters.

* fix(codeon): load revision commit preparations through dispatch lineage

Revision coverage still used the current-dispatch-only gate loader, so a
retry Dispatch could miss preparations recorded earlier in the same
Operation. Drive both public coverage loaders through isolated Postgres
after creating two Dispatches via real store APIs.

* fix(codeon): resume dirty Revision worktrees with untracked directories

git status porcelain v2 reports untracked directories with a trailing
slash. Treating that as InvalidReadback parked recoverable Revisions
on operator_cancel after restart (FWN-1 baseline-unavailable).

* fix(codeon): parse porcelain directory records without slash stripping

Porcelain v2 ?/! are record types; Git's one trailing / is the directory
marker, not a path segment. Status InvalidReadback on a descendant HEAD
is dirty progress, not operator_cancel.

* fix(codeon): retry isolated DispatchWorkerFault without operator_cancel

A modern worker that returns Err was isolated as DispatchWorkerFault then
materialized as operator_cancel. Legacy recovery only resumes after a
new runtime instance records abandonment, so FWN-13/46/51 stayed parked
and held runnable leases. Startup wakeup now treats an already-completed
worker fault as runtime-unknown and bounded-retries a replacement dispatch.

* fix(codeon): retry Review DispatchWorkerFault despite completion_observed

Isolated worker-fault recovery still returned NotApplicable when a Review
dispatch had completion_observed, so FWN-13/46 stayed on operator_cancel
after the FWN-51 path already resumed.

* fix(codeon): retry isolated Review and revision readback without operator_cancel

Isolated DispatchWorkerFault recovery promoted Review operations to
runtime-unknown, but replacement still cancelled the old dispatch and
rejected completion_observed. FWN-13/46 stayed parked. Force-fail the
finished worker dispatch and insert a replacement.

Revision capture_readback InvalidReadback still opened operator_cancel
because startup only retried baseline-unavailable. Supersede that cancel
attention to runtime-unknown and reuse the completed-dispatch retry.

* fix(codeon): allow revision readback retry after runtime-unknown budget

FWN-1 left operator_cancel after supersede because the operation had
already used MAX_RUNTIME_UNKNOWN_AUTO_RETRIES. Readback-invalid and
isolated completed-worker retries are distinct owner recoveries and
must not inherit that generic budget.

* fix(codeon): reset runtime-unknown retry budget after completed dispatch

FWN-1's readback replacement later went inspect-unknown, but the generic
owner-retry budget still counted pre-completion replacements and parked
the Attempt. Count automatic retries only after the latest succeeded
dispatch with completion_observed.

* fix(codeon): replace inspect-unknown current dispatch without budget stall

FWN-1 kept parking on runtime_outcome_unknown because the replacement that
just failed inspect was counted against MAX_RUNTIME_UNKNOWN_AUTO_RETRIES.
Do not count the current latest dispatch when applying that budget.

* fix(codeon): reset runtime-unknown budget after started dispatch

Inspect-unknown after a dispatch that actually started was still counted
against the same MAX retry generation as never-started replacements, so
FWN-1 parked at recovery_required once the worker died.

Treat a prior running_at dispatch as the generation anchor so owner retry
can replace the current inspect-unknown dispatch. Never-started loops
still stop at the durable budget.

* fix(codeon): map legacy unsealed runtime profile to the only available one

Issue routing that omitted a runtime profile was stored as
__codeon_legacy_unsealed__, which is reserved and not configurable.
Environment planning then skipped AgentRuntimeProfileUnavailable forever,
so FWN-18/35/69 sat in awaiting_environment_plan while holding started
capacity.

If the sentinel is selected and exactly one runtime profile exists for
that agent kind (or default is configured), use it. Ambiguous or missing
profiles still fail closed.

* fix(codeon): recover Cursor terminal-without-completion without operator_cancel

retry_agent_failure_if_recoverable only adopted Codex idle-without-completion
evidence. Cursor/Grok terminal-without-completion exhausted MAX=3 into
ResultInvalid + operator_cancel, then startup returned attempt_not_ready
because the matcher was Codex-only and live-session preflight blocked a
dead Cursor session.

Treat the published Cursor/Grok/fake terminal-without-completion strings as
recoverable, skip live-session preflight for that class, and promote a
fresh fenced dispatch the same way Codex already does.

* fix(codeon): treat live Cursor inspect/recover gaps as running

Cursor inspect StateUnavailable and recover Unknown opened
runtime_outcome_unknown while a just-started Cursor session was still
live. Owner retry then inspect-too-soon again, parking FWN-1.

Defer inspect when the session is not yet retained, skip recover while
inspect holds the session, and classify a retained live session without
prompt events as Running instead of RecoveryRequired.

* fix(codeon): replace inflight dispatch on runtime-unknown retry

Owner retry for inspect-unknown cancelled only Prepared/ProvisionSending/
Configuring/Running/RecoveryRequired. After restart, FWN-1's Cursor
dispatch was still in InputSending/RuntimeConfigured, so retry and
recheck_now refused owner_authority_changed and logged DispatchFault.

Treat inflight input/runtime states as replaceable so a parked
runtime_outcome_unknown attention can start a new dispatch.

* fix(codeon): retry isolated DispatchWorkerFault on inflight dispatch

FWN-62 revision parked at operator_cancel after DispatchWorkerFault
because isolated recovery required operation.runtime_reference plus
input_runtime_reference and only running/failed/cancelled dispatch
states. Startup then returned attempt_not_ready.

Allow isolated recovery from inflight input/runtime states without
those extra references so the same-daemon replacement dispatch can
proceed. Do not MCP-cancel.

* fix(codeon): recover isolated DispatchWorkerFault without runtime reference

Isolated recovery still rejected a prepared replacement dispatch with no
runtime_reference, so FWN-62 stayed at operator_cancel after the worker
died. Allow missing runtime/input references on the isolated path and
match the live prepared-without-reference case in the fixture.

* fix(codeon): count consecutive terminal-without-completion failures

Lifetime TWC counts on a long revision opened operator_cancel after three
historical deaths, then startup retry undid the fail without a budget.
Count only the consecutive TWC streak after the last non-TWC dispatch,
honor that budget on both retry paths, and do not require a runtime
reference for recoverable Cursor/Grok/fake TWC recovery.

* fix(codeon): keep live Cursor running across inspect/recover gaps

Inspect StateUnavailable and recover Unknown opened recovery_required
and replaced FWN-1's live Cursor dispatch every few minutes. The UI
flashed revision/recovery_required while patrol sampled running.

Treat those provider readback gaps as Running instead of replacing
the inflight dispatch, matching Codex inspect-timeout deferral.

* fix(codeon): treat dead Cursor inspect/recover gaps as terminal

Keeping live Cursor inspect/recover readback as Running left FWN-1
zombie-running after the process exited with no last_activity.

If the Cursor process group is gone, recover/inspect gaps now return
terminal-without-completion so replacement can proceed; a live process
still defers as Running.

* fix(codeon): retry Cursor process-exited TWC instead of parking

Dead Cursor recover/inspect now returns terminal-without-completion with
process-exited evidence, but that evidence was not in the owner-retry
allowlist. Consecutive TWC budget also counted dispatches that had already
run for minutes. FWN-1 then parked on operator_cancel after a live Cursor
died during smoke-e2e. Allow the new evidence and reset the consecutive
budget after a dispatch ran for 60s so Codeon replaces the agent instead
of waiting for cancel.

* fix(codeon): always retry Cursor process-exited TWC

Consecutive TWC budget still parked FWN-1 on operator_cancel after
recover-process-exited because those dispatches often die in under 60s.
Skip the consecutive fail-closed path for inspect/recover process-exited
evidence so a dead Cursor is replaced instead of waiting for cancel.

* fix(cursor): reap leftover process group after leader exit

Cursor ACP leaves worker-server/tsserver in the process group after the
agent leader exits. Shutdown treated that as AlreadyExited/Reaped and
skipped killpg, so leftovers kept killpg(pgid,0) alive and poisoned the
next session/prompt in the same worktree (FWN-1 recovery_required flash).

* fix(codeon): skip inspect-unknown budget after TWC

Terminal-without-completion replacements still opened runtime_unknown
attention, so process-exited Cursor retries burned MAX=3 and parked
FWN-1 at runtime_unknown_retry_budget_exhausted. TWC keeps its own
consecutive budget; inspect-unknown must not double-count it.

* fix(codeon): retry isolated DWF when dispatch row is missing

FWN-70 Review parked on DispatchWorkerFault/operator_cancel because
startup isolated recovery treated a missing dispatch as an invariant
and never created a replacement. Isolated recover now promotes to
runtime-unknown and inserts the first prepared dispatch from the
binding.

* fix(codeon): match isolated missing-dispatch DWF without running from_state

FWN-70 Review still parked after the missing-dispatch retry: the
isolated recover required from_state=running, but the live DWF event
does not. Non-isolated missing dispatch is NotApplicable so startup
can fall through to isolated retry.

* fix(codeon): allow DWF reclassification without running from_state

Promote isolated missing-dispatch DWF to runtime-unknown was rejected
because the recovery lifecycle guard still required from_state=running.

* fix(codeon): keep live recover gaps running

677081b7 classified dead Cursor as TWC but also reverted
c3f49d21's recover-path deferral. Recover Unknown/StateUnavailable
then opened runtime_outcome_unknown, owner-retried, and flashed
FWN-1 revision/recovery_required while list_execution_attentions
lagged.

Restore recover-gap ObservedRunning. Cursor process-exited TWC
still replaces.

Pre-operation Git timeout recovery has no runtime authority to resume and otherwise parks forever. Abandon the never-dispatched attempt and requeue its Issue atomically.

* fix(codeon): bound terminal recovery retries

* fix(codeon): park exhausted terminal retries

* fix(codeon): stabilize completion recovery

Read durable completion by dispatch input authority and honor the frozen Cursor continuation budget. Version corrected terminal evidence so historical Cursor and Grok failures receive one compatibility retry without reopening the dispatch loop.

* fix(codeon): retry first v3 recovery once

Use durable dispatch evidence counts so stale operations get one rollout retry while a second v3 terminal failure still parks.
